connectorUiConfig.title: Workday Email Activity
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [Workday](https://www.workday.com/) Email Activity data connector provides the capability to ingest Email Activity reports from [Workday Custom Reports API](https://community.workday.com/sites/default/files/file-hosting/restapi/index.html) into Microsoft Sentinel.

sampleQueries.description: Get a sample of Workday Email Activity logs
sampleQueries.query:
{{graphQueriesTableName}}
 | where EventProduct == "Workday" and Operation == "Email Activity" | take 10

customs.name: Workday Custom Report API access
customs.description: Access to the Workday Custom Report API through OAuth is required. The API Client needs access to the ISU_MS_Sentinel integration system user and the CR_Sentinel_Email_ID_Change custom report.

instructionSteps.description:
1) In Workday, access the "Edit Tenant Setup - Security" task, verify "OAuth 2.0 Settings" section, make sure that the "OAuth 2.0 Clients Enabled" check box is ticked. 
 2) Access the "Register API Client" task.
 3) Define the Client Name, select the "Client Grant Type": "Authorization Code Grant" and then select "Access Token Type": "Bearer"
 4) Enter the "Redirection URI" found in the form below 
 5) In section "Scope (Functional Areas)", select the appropriate scope for the custom report and click OK at the bottom 
 6) Copy the Client ID and Client Secret before navigating away from the page, and store it securely. 
 7) In Sentinel, in the connector page - provide required Token, Authorization and Email Activity Report Endpoints, along with Client ID and Client Secret from previous step. Then click "Connect".
instructionSteps.title: Connect to Workday to start collecting Email Activity logs in Microsoft Sentinel
